identity: Likely Libby Larsen: Song Concerto (2005), catalog title shortened to Concerto
findings: The exact candidate is Song Concerto (2005),21 minutes, for a single soloist doubling alto and soprano with piano or chamber orchestra. UNT's 2024 DMA guide identifies this as Larsen's only saxophone concerto.

Four movements: In Dance; Cri de Coeur; Mozart's Starling; Abandon. Commissioned by Barlow Endowment and Eugene Rousseau's students; premiered 15February 2006 by Rousseau with University of Iowa Orchestra, William Jones.
Libby Larsen Publishing provides the 76-page public orchestral perusal. The score carries 2006/2008 copyright, distinct from composition 2005.
Catalog's generic Concerto title and alto-only scoring require confirmation before applying candidate metadata.

score_observations: Candidate Song Concerto, first page: alto solo enters raucously at quarter 104 with chromatic sextuplet runs, accented notes and grace gestures;4/4 changes briefly to 3/8.

MovementII printed page 55 explicitly changes soloist to B-flat soprano. Slowly, extremely free, quarter≈63 uses parenthesized beat counts, push-ahead/pull-back timing and a broad dynamic swell to ff over drone textures.
Full score appears in concert pitch. Do not infer transposed saxophone range from displayed pitches. Piano reduction was not inspected.
